name: Strike Ffa
description:
InPvP is a Minecraft Bedrock Edition network operating several multiplayer servers and experiences across mobile devices, consoles, and Windows.

The network includes projects such as Mineville Zeqa, MegaSMP, Genwars, and Oneblock Online. Players can discover a variety of gameplay styles, including Earth survival, Prison, Oneblock, Lifesteal, competitive PvP, player economies, progression systems, and community events.

Each InPvP project offers its own worlds, objectives, rankings, and features, giving players a selection of both competitive and progression-focused experiences. Join the network to explore its available servers and find the game mode that suits your playstyle.
